mission: Test Suite Recovery: Achieve 100% Green Suite for Autonomous Development

tasks.title: Analyze segfault at socket.py:295
tasks.description: Investigate segfault occurring at socket.py:295 in accept() during test execution. This appears to be in pytest_rerunfailures plugin. Determine if this is related to Python 3.13, asyncio tests, or pytest plugin interaction. Review test files around the 60-test mark where segfault consistently occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified (Python 3.13 incompatibility, plugin bug, or test code issue)

tasks.title: Catalog all test failures and hangs
tasks.description: Run test suite with --tb=no to catalog all failures without stopping. Identify: (1) Segfaulting tests, (2) Hanging tests (checkpoint_manager, vectorstore_performance), (3) Assertion failures (the ~78 'F' markers). Create comprehensive inventory with test names, failure types, and priority.
acceptance_criteria: Complete list of all failing tests with failure types

tasks.title: Fix run_tests.py double execution bug
tasks.description: run_tests.py currently runs tests twice: first with pytest-xdist (progress shown), then again with 'uv run pytest' sequentially (causing timeout). The second run starts around 51% and hangs. Remove the duplicate sequential run from run_tests.py lines 403-537.

tasks.title: Eliminate segfault in socket tests
tasks.description: Fix the segfault occurring at socket.py:295 during pytest execution. Based on analysis from phase_1, apply appropriate fix: (1) Disable pytest-rerunfailures plugin, (2) Add pytest.mark.no_retry to problematic async tests, (3) Isolate socket-based tests with serial marker, or (4) Pin Python version if 3.13 incompatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause documented in commit message

tasks.title: Fix test_vectorstore_performance.py segfault
tasks.description: test_vectorstore_performance.py causes segfault even when run sequentially (not xdist-related). This suggests PyTorch/transformers issue or memory corruption. Options: (1) Skip/quarantine test, (2) Fix memory leak, (3) Isolate in subprocess, (4) Mock VectorStore for performance tests.
acceptance_criteria: Tests pass or are properly quarantined with documentation

tasks.title: Fix test_checkpoint_manager.py hang at test 9/20
tasks.description: test_checkpoint_manager.py hangs at test 9/20. Investigate: (1) Infinite loop, (2) Deadlock in async code, (3) Blocking I/O without timeout, (4) Resource leak. Add timeouts, fix deadlock, or quarantine test with explanation.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause fixed or test quarantined with clear documentation

tasks.title: Fix first 20 assertion failures
tasks.description: Fix the first 20 of the ~78 failing assertions ('F' markers). Run tests with --tb=short to get detailed failure info. Fix actual bugs in code or update tests to reflect correct behavior. Prioritize: (1) Easy fixes (typos, outdated expectations), (2) Logic errors, (3) Architectural issues.
acceptance_criteria: All fixes include regression test coverage

tasks.title: Fix remaining assertion failures
tasks.description: Fix remaining ~58 failing assertions from catalog. Continue methodology from batch_1. If any tests represent broken features, document as known issues with clear repro steps and mark as @pytest.mark.skip(reason='Known issue: <JIRA-123>').
acceptance_criteria: All assertion failures fixed or documented
Known issues tracked with skip markers
Test suite shows only PASSED/SKIPPED (no FAILED)

tasks.title: Determine safe pytest-xdist configuration
tasks.description: After fixing segfaults and hangs, re-enable pytest-xdist cautiously. Test with: (1) -n 1 (single worker), (2) -n 2, (3) -n 4, (4) -n auto. Identify maximum safe parallelism without crashes. Document which tests need @pytest.mark.serial.
acceptance_criteria: Optimal worker count determined (stability vs. speed)

tasks.title: Update pytest.ini with optimized configuration
tasks.description: Update pytest.ini with findings from investigation. Re-enable pytest-xdist with safe worker count. Add necessary ignores for quarantined tests. Configure proper timeouts. Ensure run_tests.py respects pytest.ini settings.

tasks.title: Simplify run_tests.py to respect pytest.ini
tasks.description: Refactor run_tests.py to be a thin wrapper around pytest that respects pytest.ini configuration. Remove duplicate test execution logic. Keep Docker lifecycle management and environment setup. Delegate all pytest behavior to pytest.ini.
acceptance_criteria: All pytest config comes from pytest.ini

tasks.title: Run complete test suite to 100% green
tasks.description: Execute full test suite with 'python run_tests.py --run-all' and verify 100% pass rate. Run 3 times to ensure stability (no flakiness). Document: (1) Total test count, (2) Execution time, (3) Any skipped tests with reasons, (4) Performance vs. baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Execution time documented (baseline for future optimization)

tasks.title: Document test suite recovery in ADR
tasks.description: Create ADR-030-test-suite-recovery.md documenting: (1) Root causes of test failures (segfault, double execution, assertion failures), (2) Fixes applied, (3) New testing practices to prevent regression, (4) Quarantined tests and their future remediation plan.
acceptance_criteria: ADR explains all root causes with evidence

tasks.title: Validate Article II compliance
tasks.description: Verify that restored test suite upholds Article II: 100% verification and stability. Update constitution.md if needed to codify new testing practices (e.g., mandatory @pytest.mark.serial for async network tests). Ensure pre-commit hooks enforce test pass requirement.
acceptance_criteria: New testing practices documented in constitution

checkpoints.prompt: Verify diagnostic analysis identified root causes before proceeding to fixes
Verify all critical blockers (segfaults, hangs) are resolved before fixing assertion failures
Verify pytest configuration is stable before final validation
